Title: The end of Jyhad as we know it ???

Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
My, what a catchy title !! ;-)

I was just wondering : with BH, we now have roughly equivalent numbers of
vampires in each Clan, the balance seems about perfect ; some nice
interesting new cards came out, it doesn't look like anymore are needed for
game balance or interest.

So, what will come up next ?

Group 4 ? Whole new mechanisms ? Compatible games ? Or just more cards going
on forever, needed or not ?

My wishes :

- no Group 4, ever
- new mechanisms in Gehenna (and BIIIIIG vampires !!!)
- then, totally different things, be they allies, Dark Ages, or whatever
- and a longer schedule between releases ; 9 months at least, one year would
be better (I'll put a poll on that subject on http://necrobones.free.fr).

Orpheus

> - then, totally different things, be they allies, Dark Ages, or whatever

As I said, allies seem more fitting for Gehenna... Dark Ages? Sure, why
not... Group "-1" or some such...

Thomas

This has been addressed in the past by White Wolf staff. (You are
free to wish to the contrary, of course) Steve Wieck (or maybe Chad
Brown?) posted that they have serious trouble keeping retailers
interested in stocking the game when they run a longer release
schedule. Being used to a 6 month release, maximum, the game 'drops
off their radar' with a longer schedule. Its not best for the game
from a card mechanics standpoint, but it is being done to preserve the
game financially. It won't likely be changed.

> >Speaking of Dark Ages, why not a Group 0 ?
>
> because they could be used with group 1?

Yes. That was the intent. Then the largely available (to players) pool of
1/2 vampires would be surrounded by 3 and 0 instead of putting group 4 to
the end of the chain which makes any pre-cam-ed vampires completely useless
(when playing with the new group). Probably there could be even a
"wrap-around" rule making the vampires of 0 both usable with 1 and 3, in
this case the new group can be also called 4, of course :-)
